failures.description: The full relay stream includes window-procedure/DLL lifecycle messages despite API selection. All four traces hit the 16 MiB retained-byte cap. Complete GUI frames remain valid, but API-absence/complete-log conclusions are excluded.
The caller passed the (metadata,array) crop result to difference before unpacking it. No comparison file was emitted. Corrected analysis reuses the original captures; no GUI retry or normalization.

limitations: The default RelayFromExclude remains active; these are selected public entry-point observations, not complete call graphs.

No selected glyph-outline/data/index call occurs in viewer traces, while all occur in independent positive probes. Absence does not establish a universal absence of GDI or identify an internal font engine.
No HG-prefixed content face appears in retained NtGdiHfontCreate messages; UI-related face names are retained.

The last SetDIBitsToDevice arguments and scan-line returns agree across each source/PDF pair and are consistent with observed page interior sizes. Bitmap headers and pixels passed to the call are not read, and complete drawing state is not reconstructed.
All source/PDF frames still differ; no production, actual-corpus, native/Node/browser parity or final acceptance improvement is claimed.
Raw discarded messages are not recoverable. Final selected records have zero cap drops; the filter cap and exclusion are independently exercised on an original stream.
